admission_price: Free admission to pumpkin patch; pumpkins sold by weight ($0.80/lb for Jack-O'-lanterns, $0.65/lb for Jumbo Jacks 45+ lbs, $1.50/lb for specialty squash small/medium, $1/lb large); Sunflower Maze $5 per person over 7 years; School Field Trips $7/child
activities: U-pick pumpkin patch; sunflower maze; hay playground; hay maze; hay pyramid; petting zoo; face painting; master pumpkin carving demonstrations; local vendors (crafts, art, food, drinks)
season_dates: September 26 - October 31, 2026; Pumpkin Patch open weekends 10am-6pm, weekdays 12pm-6pm; Falloween Fair October 10-11 and 17-18, 10am-6pm
extra_notes: Free admission to pumpkin patch. Accepts cash, credit/debit cards, and local checks. No dogs allowed except approved service animals. School field trips available Tuesday-Friday mornings (email to schedule). Over 11 acres with 50+ pumpkin varieties and 60+ squash varieties. Mobile petting zoo and alpaca farm visiting weekends in October. Food vendors available most weekends in October.
